Pertaining to Senator Cassidy wanting to ingratiate himself with Trump...

I'm reminded of the great exchange between Thomas More and Richard Rich in "A Man for All Seasons."  

To secure his new title as Attorney General for Wales, Rich commits perjury at More's treason trial. He falsely testifies that More explicitly denied Parliament’s authority over the Church. Following this betrayal, More delivers the play's most famous rebuke:

"Why Richard, it profits a man nothing to give his soul for the whole world... but for Wales?"
